title: Waikato

rec2.n: Pikiawatea Stream or Blue Duck Stream

sections.source: Commercial rafting listings describe the dam-release Wairoa as Grade 5. Extent approximate (whole steep river).
Sean: one of the top Kaimai runs (spelled Tuakopai locally). Grade not recorded yet.
Sean: known locally as a flood run; not in online guides. Held out from training.
Karangahake Gorge: Class IV-IV+ bouldery rapids above Karangahake, flood only (industry report). Extent approximate: 4 km above Karangahake.
